                    WHERE ingest.selected_at(%s,s.recorded_from_gen,s.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT s.is_deleted
                    AND s.match_id=p.match_id AND s.source_id=p.source_id AND s.variant_key=p.variant_key)
                FROM ingest.match_coverage p WHERE ingest.selected_at(%s,p.recorded_from_gen,p.recorded_to_gen)
                AND p.feature_code='shots' AND (SELECT count(*) FROM football.shots s
                    WHERE ingest.selected_at(%s,s.recorded_from_gen,s.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT s.is_deleted
                    AND s.match_id=p.match_id AND s.source_id=p.source_id AND s.variant_key=p.variant_key)
                    <> COALESCE(p.observed_row_count,0)
